headline: Anthem Biosciences: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Ajay Bhardwaj has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulations 31(4)–31(5) signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Anthem Biosciences Limited, a pharma-focused biotech company, with filing date 23 June 2026.
implication: Disclosure triggers mandatory transparency of shareholding thresholds; acquirer and target board must monitor ongoing regulatory compliance milestones under takeover code (open offer thresholds, voting agreements, pledges).
detail: The filing constitutes a formal disclosure by Ajay Bhardwaj under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a crossing of one or more prescribed shareholding thresholds in Anthem Biosciences Limited. No public announcement of acquisition quantum, consideration or terms is currently available in secondary sources. Anthem Biosciences is a drug-discovery and biotech research company listed on NSE/BSE. The disclosure was submitted to NSE on 23 June 2026.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 31(4)–31(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure when acquirer crosses 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, 55% thresholds; requires disclosure of acquirer name, address, intent, funding source, collateral pledges.

framework.ref: SEBI Regulations, Reg. 4 – Definition of 'Acquirer' and 'Associate'
framework.note: Determines scope of persons/entities whose shareholding aggregates toward threshold; critical for group structure analysis.
Identifies exemptions from open offer requirement (e.g. acquisition by promoter, preferential issue, buyback, inheritance); determines if mandatory open offer is triggered.
If acquisition results in change of control, CSR reporting and clause (5) board disclosure obligations flow; Anthem likely subject if turnover >₹500 cr.

framework.ref: Insider Trading Regulation (SEBI PIT Regulations, 2015), Reg. 3–4
framework.note: Acquirer and associates must comply with blackout/trading window provisions; disclosure of acquisition intent triggers insider list obligations for target.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA), if applicable
framework.note: If Ajay Bhardwaj or funder is non-resident, FDI approval under Press Note 3 / sectoral caps may be required; pharma M&A scrutiny varies.
Substantial Acquisition is a 'Materiality Event' requiring immediate disclosure; Anthem must announce within 30 minutes of NSE/BSE close.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961, Section 56(2)(vii) / Securities Transactions Tax (STT)
framework.note: Capital gains tax on acquisition; if equity, no STT if listed; but stamp duty on share transfer may apply if off-market.

conditions: Crossing of prescribed shareholding threshold (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, or 55%)
Disclosure of acquirer identity, funding source, intent (control/investment/cooperation), collateral pledges, associates
approvals: FDI approval (if foreign acquirer, pharma sector)
structure.novel: Regulation 31(4)–31(5) disclosure in June 2026; no precedent-setting structure noted from available sources.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 31
triggers.note: Threshold crossing triggers mandatory disclosure within 2 trading days; non-compliance attracts penalties up to ₹25 lakh + imprisonment under SEBI Act.
Materiality Event: Anthem must announce acquirer disclosure and shareholding to public simultaneously with BSE/NSE filing.
If acquisition crosses 25% or results in control, shareholding must be notified to MCA within 30 days; director(s) appointed by acquirer subject to Section 152 validation.
